title: Photo Booth Hire Berkshire | Boothdrop Entertainment
metaDescription: Photo booth hire across Berkshire, from Reading and Slough to Windsor and Newbury. Packages from £299 with attendant and setup. Call 07368 631 516.
intro: Looking for photo booth hire in Berkshire? Boothdrop Entertainment serves the whole M4 corridor, from Hungerford and Newbury in the west through Reading and Bracknell to Windsor, Maidenhead and Slough. Every package from £299 includes a professional attendant, delivery and setup, unlimited sessions and a personalised print design, and an £80 deposit holds your date.

sections.heading: Thames hotels, racecourse towns and business parks
paragraphs: Berkshire's venues fall into a few recognisable groups. Along the Thames between Windsor and Reading there are hotels and restaurants with terraces over the water, popular for summer weddings and anniversary dinners. Windsor and Ascot bring grand country houses and estate venues, often with ballrooms and long gravel approaches. Further west, the farmland around Newbury, Thatcham and Hungerford is dotted with converted barns and farm venues that suit rustic styling.

The business parks of Reading, Bracknell and Slough generate a steady stream of corporate work: product launches, awards nights, summer socials and Christmas parties held in conference centres and hotel function suites. Golf clubs across the county, village halls in the smaller communities and school halls for proms round out the picture.

sections.heading: The booths Berkshire clients book most
paragraphs: The Selfie Mirror Pod has become a favourite for Berkshire weddings and corporate events because it combines a mirror-style screen with a DSLR camera and instant prints for every guest, yet only needs a two-metre square of floor. It fits comfortably into a hotel function suite or a barn corner without blocking the dance floor.

Budget-conscious bookings lean on the LCD SlimPod, which delivers prints, GIFs and background removal from a 36-centimetre-wide pod. Tech companies around Reading and Bracknell often choose the GIF Booth for digital-only sharing with a branded animated overlay, while larger celebrations in Windsor and Ascot ballrooms go for the LED-lit Inflatable Booth, whose glow we can match to the event colours.
list: Selfie Mirror Pod: instant prints, DSLR quality, slim footprint
LCD SlimPod: the most affordable option with prints and digital
GIF Booth: digital-only, ideal for brand activations
Inflatable Booth: showpiece for ballrooms and large groups

sections.heading: Towns and roads we cover
paragraphs: Reading and Slough are busy enough for us that each has its own page with local parking and venue notes. Between and around them we set up regularly in Windsor, Maidenhead, Bracknell, Wokingham, Ascot and Sandhurst, with Newbury, Thatcham and Hungerford covered to the west of the county.

The M4 is the spine of most Berkshire journeys, with M25 junction 15 linking us to Slough and Windsor and the A329 carrying us between Reading, Wokingham and Bracknell. Newbury-area venues are reached via the A34. Wherever the venue sits, delivery and setup are already included in the package price.

sections.heading: Planning notes for Berkshire weddings, corporate events and parties
paragraphs: Slough and Reading both have large South Asian communities, and Asian weddings are a big part of our Berkshire calendar. For these events we recommend placing the booth away from the stage and near the entrance to the hall, so guests can use it during the arrival period and again after dinner. Print templates can carry both English and Punjabi, Gujarati or Urdu text, and our attendant is used to managing a lively queue of several hundred guests.

Corporate bookings at Reading and Bracknell business parks usually want a logo on every print, a branded overlay on the GIFs and a digital gallery delivered afterwards for internal communications. Proms in Bracknell, Maidenhead and Wokingham schools run early in the evening, so we schedule setup during the afternoon. Birthday parties and Christmas parties in village halls and golf clubs are the most relaxed of the lot, and the LCD SlimPod or Retro Pod usually fits the budget and the room.

sections.heading: Access, power and setup on the day
paragraphs: Hotels along the Thames often have underground or limited parking, so we ask in advance where the loading entrance is and whether a goods lift is available. Country houses near Windsor and Ascot tend to have long gravel drives; we unload at the nearest door and carry the kit in on trolleys. Barns around Newbury can have uneven stone floors, which is fine provided there is a level two-metre area for the booth.

Setup takes between 45 minutes and an hour before the hire window opens and is not charged as hire time. Every booth bar the Inflatable Booth runs from one standard socket. For marquees on country estates, a reliable 13A supply is essential; if the marquee company is supplying a generator, please confirm it is rated for lighting and catering as well as the booth, and we will liaise with them directly if that helps.

faqs.q: Where will you park at a Thames-side hotel with limited spaces?
faqs.a: Most riverside hotels have a loading area or a side entrance for suppliers, and we ask the venue coordinator for its location before the day. We unload there, move the vehicle to the staff or overflow car park and return at the end of the evening to pack down, so no guest space is taken.

faqs.q: Can you set up in a marquee at a country house near Windsor or Ascot?
faqs.a: Yes, we set up in marquees regularly. We need a firm, level floor, cover from the weather and a reliable 13A socket within reach. If power comes from a generator, let us know in advance so we can confirm the supply is steady enough for the printer and lighting.

faqs.q: Are there travel fees for Berkshire venues?
faqs.a: No separate travel charge applies to the vast majority of Berkshire bookings, because delivery and setup are included in every package. If any travel contribution ever applies to a far-flung venue it is shown on the quote up front, never added afterwards.

faqs.q: Do you work with Asian wedding venues in Slough and Reading?
faqs.a: Frequently. We are familiar with the large banqueting halls in both towns and the timings of a typical ceremony and reception. The print template can include names in English and a second language, and we can match colours to the mandap or stage decor.

faqs.q: Can the prints carry our company logo for a Reading business park event?
faqs.a: Yes, every booking includes a custom template with text and a logo. Send us your artwork and brand colours when you book and we will design the layout for approval before the event. GIFs and digital copies carry the same branding.
